summary: Frontend-only verification of the new Attendance Mode (Normal/GPS/GPS+Selfie) feature on /admin/attendance and /employee/attendance. All 8 required scenarios passed end-to-end with Playwright + mocked geolocation.
scenarios_tested: Admin policy card renders below Office Timing with testid att-policy-card and current badge 'Active: Normal · office location not set'.
GPS and GPS+Selfie mode buttons are DISABLED when office lat/lng empty; Normal remains enabled.
Entering lat 23.7117 / lng 76.0157 enables GPS buttons and reveals att-policy-map-link.
Save GPS mode → success toast → badge becomes 'Active: GPS only (within office radius) · 100 m'. Reload persists lat/lng/mode.
Employee rahul.k /employee/attendance shows chip 'Live GPS required within 100 m of office' (and ' · selfie at check-in' in gps_selfie mode).
Mocked position FAR from office (28.6,77.2) → att-check-in → toast 'You are 556244 m away from the office. Attendance is allowed only within 100 m of the office.' (correct).
Mocked position AT office (23.7117,76.0157) → att-check-in → success toast 'Checked in at …'; today-in populated; att-check-out → success toast; today-out populated.
Admin AttendanceTab shows new GPS/Selfie column (adm-att-gps-<id>-<date>) with '📍 In 0 m · Out 0 m' for Rahul today.

GPS+Selfie mode: badge 'Active: GPS + Selfie · 100 m'. Employee att-check-in opens selfie-dialog (data-testid selfie-dialog). Capture button present, not disabled (headless chromium had working fake media stream). selfie-close dismisses dialog cleanly.
Per-employee override: setting att-emp-mode-<rahulId> to 'normal' and back to 'Default' both show success toast 'Employee attendance mode updated'.
Final RESTORE: policy mode = normal (badge 'Active: Normal · 100 m'); Rahul's today attendance deleted from DB; attendance_selfie files cleared.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning: <span data-ve-dynamic='true'> inside <option> on AttendanceTab.jsx line 104 (att-filter-emp). Dev-mode only but still present — carried over from iteration_27 report, not fixed yet.

critical_code_review_comments: attendance_policy.py keeps the policy in a module-level dict _P (lines 15-16) that is only loaded at startup via load(db). Direct DB writes bypass this cache. In single-worker preview this is fine (admin PUT updates _P via save()), but with multiple backend workers behind a load balancer, each worker will serve a stale policy until restart. Consider reading from db.settings on every verify_punch / get_policy call, or publishing a change event, or using a short TTL cache.

AttendancePolicyCard shows '· now: Normal/GPS/GPS+Selfie' in each override row — the effective_mode is only refreshed when the whole policy GET is re-run after override save; this works because setEmp calls apply(data).

Minor copy nit: when no office is set, the badge reads 'Active: Normal · office location not set' which is good, but for GPS mode when office IS set the badge is 'Active: GPS only (within office radius) · 100 m' — consider including office_label when present for better operator feedback.
action_items: (Optional) Make attendance policy read-through from settings (or add TTL cache) to avoid per-worker staleness in multi-worker deployments.
(Carryover from iter_27) Fix React hydration warning in AttendanceTab.jsx line 104 — avoid wrapping option label text in a <span>.
